decisions.title: Acquisition negotiation basis
decisions.exact_decision_statement: The current nonbinding working opening-offer basis is $7,500,000. It is a tactical negotiation figure, not an economically supported land value, not proof of value, not a price ceiling, not a walk-away price, and not authority to submit an offer. The governing feasibility conclusion is unchanged: the tested program does not support the land at any price, including zero. No offer submission or acquisition is authorized. The modeled land basis remains $8,000,000 and is not restated; the two bases are never blended. Negotiating authority, maximum price, walk-away price, final conditions, transaction structure, and applicant identity remain unresolved.
evidence_or_rationale: Context preserved not adopted: S8 p.7 defensible range $7.65-9.0M
